description.value: Nonna's Cucina Pop-up is an intimate Italian restaurant on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, relocated from its original Hastings Street home and helmed by Joe Fazio. The menu centres on handmade pasta with chef-selected sauces, appetizers, cocktails, and Italian wines served in a lively neighbourhood setting. The restaurant positions itself as an ongoing pop-up experience celebrating classic Italian home cooking.
